## Attachments

1. One copy of each document specified in the subparagraphs of Article 4(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Special Cases concerning the Payment of Retirement Compensation to Public Officials Disqualified from Appointment and Others.

## Instructions for completion

1. In field ①, enter the date on which the appointing authority or authority recommending appointment received the application.

2. In field ②, enter the name of the institution exercising appointment or recommendation authority in the first part of the receipt number and the serial number in the second part (example: Ministry of Personnel Management – 1).

3. In field ③, enter the institution, grade (rank), salary step and monthly basic salary at the end of the person's actual public service.

4. In field ④, enter the person's first appointment date as a public official.

5. In field ⑤, enter the date and grounds of the disqualification from appointment or automatic retirement.

6. In field ⑥, select the reason why the person falls outside Article 3 of the Act on Special Cases concerning the Payment of Retirement Compensation to Public Officials Disqualified from Appointment and Others, and mark it with “Ⅴ”.

7. In field ⑦, enter the actual service period under Article 2, subparagraph 4, of that Act in the total-period field, calculated by the method for service periods under the Public Officials Pension Act or the Military Pension Act. In the service-period fields, separately enter actual service after appointment and periods combined, aggregated or credited as service under either Act.

8. In field ⑧, enter the figures after checking the calculation statement for the lump-sum retirement (military retirement) pension or lump-sum retirement benefit, and the retirement allowance or additional retirement benefit, obtained and certified upon request to the President of the Government Employees Pension Corporation (the Minister of National Defense for actual military service).

9. In field ⑨, enter the contributions paid during actual service plus interest calculated by the Government Employees Pension Corporation with regard to the Government Employees Pension Fund's investment return (for actual military service, the contribution refund interest rate under Article 5(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Military Pension Act). Verify the amount using the calculation statement for the lump-sum pension or retirement benefit and retirement allowance or additional retirement benefit obtained and certified by the Corporation's President (the Minister of National Defense for military personnel).

10. In field ⑩, enter the total in field ⑧ less the refund of contribution principal and interest in field ⑨.

11. In field ⑪, calculate and enter interest on the retirement compensation at 5 percent per year from the end of actual public service to the date compensation is paid.

12. In field ⑫, enter the payment amount: compensation (⑩) plus interest (⑪).

13. In field ⑬, enter the financial institution (post office) at which the eligible person wishes to receive the compensation and the account number.
